mapper.select: SELECT st.shoe_id, st.size_id, st.stock_quantity, s.name as shoe_name, s.serial_number, sz.shoe_size FROM stock st LEFT JOIN shoes s ON st.shoe_id = s.shoe_id LEFT JOIN sizes sz ON st.size_id = sz.size_id ORDER BY st.shoe_id, st.size_id
